mcpSetup.description.source: Connect Codex, Claude Code, or Cursor to Keryx research and pay cited creators in Arc USDC.
mcpSetup.description.text: 将 Codex、Claude Code 或 Cursor 连接到 Keryx 研究，并使用 Arc USDC 向被引用创作者付款。

mcpSetup.codexDetail.source: Add once from your terminal. Discover free paper metadata, research and service-status tools.
mcpSetup.codexDetail.text: 从终端添加一次。发现免费论文元数据、研究和服务状态工具。

mcpSetup.claudeDetail.source: Register Keryx as a remote HTTP server in your current Claude scope.
mcpSetup.claudeDetail.text: 在当前 Claude 范围内将 Keryx 注册为远程 HTTP 服务器。

mcpSetup.cursorDetail.source: Paste this server entry into your Cursor MCP configuration.
mcpSetup.cursorDetail.text: 将此服务器条目粘贴到 Cursor MCP 配置。

mcpSetup.title.source: One URL. Every agent. Creators get paid.
mcpSetup.title.text: 一个 URL，连接所有智能体，向创作者付款。

mcpSetup.introduction.source: Give your MCP client a budgeted research tool. Keryx finds relevant writing, settles citation rewards in Arc USDC, and returns the answer with a public receipt.
mcpSetup.introduction.text: 为 MCP 客户端提供有预算限制的研究工具。Keryx 寻找相关内容，使用 Arc USDC 结算引用奖励，并返回答案和公开凭证。

mcpSetup.tagBoundary.source: The client tag measures which setup path works. It does not identify or authorize you.
mcpSetup.tagBoundary.text: 客户端标签用于衡量哪个设置路径有效。它不会识别或授权您。

mcpSetup.keySetup.text: 使用 API 密钥设置

mcpSetup.researchTitle.source: Ask for research, not a search

mcpSetup.researchIntroduction.source: Tell your agent to use Keryx. The response includes cited creators, reward amounts, confidence, settlement status, and a dispatch URL.
mcpSetup.researchIntroduction.text: 让您的智能体使用 Keryx。响应包含被引用创作者、奖励金额、置信度、结算状态和研究任务 URL。

mcpSetup.identityEyebrow.text: 先匿名使用，准备好后验证

mcpSetup.limitBoundary.source: Try Remote MCP without a key. For higher limits and wallet-level attribution, create an ask-scoped API key in the developer portal. Keryx still funds creator rewards; your key controls identity and rate limits only. All keys for one wallet share the same sponsored allowance across chat and Remote MCP.
mcpSetup.limitBoundary.text: 无需密钥即可试用远程 MCP。如需更高限额和钱包级归属记录，请在开发者门户创建带 ask 权限的 API 密钥。创作者奖励仍由 Keryx 提供资金；密钥仅控制身份和速率限制。同一钱包的所有密钥在聊天和远程 MCP 间共享相同的赞助额度。

mcpSetup.paperLookup.source: Need a paper’s title, authors or DOI? Use {lookup} with its exact identifier. Catalog metadata is free; repository search requires {repositorySearch}.
mcpSetup.paperLookup.text: 需要论文标题、作者或 DOI？使用 {lookup} 和确切标识符。目录元数据免费；仓库搜索需要 {repositorySearch}。

integrationPlayground.title.text: 兼容 OpenAI 的试验区

integrationPlayground.introduction.source: The Run button calls {endpoint} exactly as any OpenAI SDK would (model {model}, {stream}). Free — no key. Watch the agent decide, then pay the creators it cites.
integrationPlayground.introduction.text: 运行按钮会像任何 OpenAI SDK 一样调用 {endpoint}（模型 {model}，{stream}）。免费，无需密钥。观察智能体作出决定，然后向其引用的创作者付款。

integrationPlayground.citations.source: Citations and planned rewards (USDC on Arc, {mode})
integrationPlayground.citations.text: 引用与计划奖励（Arc 上的 USDC，{mode}）

integrationPlayground.keyInstruction.source: Pass a {key} key (mint at {portal}) as the Bearer token for higher limits. Full schema at {schema}.
integrationPlayground.keyInstruction.text: 将 {key} 密钥（在 {portal} 创建）作为 Bearer 令牌传入，以获得更高限额。完整架构见 {schema}。
